pullRequests.title: Correct `sources` for 9 override configs
pullRequests.body:
These back-filled configs named a stale export, an editing file, an archive copy, or a file that only exists after the upstream build runs. Each now names the files the shipped fonts came from, at the same pin:

- Gayathri: the three UFOs the Makefile builds one at a time
- Cambay: the four .glyphs files, not their stale UFO exports
- Dai Banna SIL: the -VF designspaces, which have a usable default
- Lateef: lateef.designspace, not the lateef-edit editing file
- Sigmar: sources/Sigmar.glyphs, not the archived Glyphs 2 copy
- Tangerine: only Tangerine_Regular.glyphs, which has both masters
- Coda: the coda/1.0 UFOs, not the unreleased in-progress ones
- Arya: only Arya-Scaled.glyphs; the unscaled copy never shipped
- Cabin: the v3001 .glyphs files, not build.sh's designspaces

Gayathri and Lateef ship statics only, so they also get buildVariable: false. Coda Heavy (malformed lib.plist) and Arya Regular (extrapolated by Glyphs.app) still fail. Zain is left for later: its sources are .ufo.zip files, which gftools and fontc don't read.

pullRequests.title: Source metadata for 43 families changed in the past year
pullRequests.body:
* An audit of the 121 families whose fonts changed since 2025-11-13 found 48 with missing source metadata. This fixes 43, one commit per family; each adds an upstream_info.md saying how the commit and config were checked.
* config_yaml set to the upstream config (29): Agrave Pro, Akt, Alien Block, Asap Sharp, Castoro Titling, Cousine, Finlandica Headline, Finlandica Text, Firjar, Geist Serif, Geomini, Hibur Mono, Libre Caslon Condensed, Madhuban, Nevermind, Noto Sans Syriac Western, Redaction, Redaction 10, 20, 35, 50, 70 and 100, Scoutie Sans, Tinos, Valley Sans, Xmind, Yuyu, Yuyu Short.
* Commit corrected and config_yaml set (2): Caacupe One, Clarity City.
* Source block added (1): Google Sans Flex (tag v5.000).
* Override config.yaml (3): Isometra, M PLUS Code Latin, BJCree (commit also corrected to the v7.000 tag).
* Commit corrected to the CI build that holds the shipped binary byte for byte (3): Bpmf Huninn, Bpmf Iansui, Bpmf Zihi Kai Std.
* No gftools-builder config is possible, documented (4): Iosevka Charon, Iosevka Charon Mono, Datatype, M PLUS 1 Code.
* repository_url set (1): Noto Color Emoji. Its shipped version was built from a commit that was never published, so commit stays unset.
* Not in this PR: Kripa, M PLUS 1, M PLUS 2, M PLUS U and M PLUS Rounded 1c, whose upstream has no source or config that builds them.

Assisted by an AI agent (Claude Fable 5.2)

- [ ] `primary_script` definition in the METADATA.pb file for all projects that have a primary non-Latin based language support target

- [ ] Designers bio info have to be present in the designer catalog (at least an issue should be opened for tracking this, if they are not)

pullRequests.title: Recursive: remove erroneous cyrillic-ext subset (#5825)
pullRequests.body:
## Summary
Closes #5825

This PR removes the erroneous `subsets: "cyrillic-ext"` declaration from `ofl/recursive/METADATA.pb`.

## Rationale
- The Recursive font family (by Arrow Type) is designed exclusively for Latin and Vietnamese scripts.
- Verified against the variable font binary `ofl/recursive/Recursive[CASL,CRSV,MONO,slnt,wght].ttf` using `fontTools`:
  - Exactly 0 characters exist in the Cyrillic Unicode blocks (`0x0400–0x052F`, `0x2DE0–0x2DFF`, `0xA640–0xA69F`).
- Having `cyrillic-ext` declared in `METADATA.pb` causes Recursive to falsely appear in search results when users filter by Cyrillic on fonts.google.com, leading to missing glyphs / fallback rendering.
- Follows the exact metadata subset cleanup pattern from PR #11183.

## Checks
- [x] Font binary character map contains zero Cyrillic characters.
- [x] Validated `.ci/whatchanged.py` categorizes this as `CheckType.MODIFIED_FAMILY_METADATA`.
- [x] Protobuf syntax and formatting validated.

pullRequests.title: Update test_font_tags.py
pullRequests.body:
In adding a bunch of new tag data to the `families.csv`, I realized that there are situations where a tag may be active at the default location (MONO@0), but be inactive at a different location (MONO@1). "Monospace/Monospace" is a great example which can be set to 100 at the default location but needs to be set to 0 at other instances on the variable axis. 

This PR implements a change to the test_font_tags file to allow this to occur. It is required for https://github.com/google/fonts/pull/10688 to move forward.

pullRequests.title: Fix broken links in OFL font descriptions (update moved, remove dead)
pullRequests.body:
## What this PR does
This PR cleans up external links across `ofl/**/DESCRIPTION*.html`. Every link in
these files was tested, and broken ones were handled in one of three ways:

**1. Updated links that only moved** (the content still exists, just at a new URL):
- Legacy `google.com/fonts/specimen/<Family>` and `google.com/webfonts/specimen/<Family>`
  URLs → updated to `https://fonts.google.com/specimen/<Family>`.
- Plain `http://` links whose `https://` version is live → upgraded to HTTPS.
- A few sites that rebranded/moved → pointed to their current address.

**2. Removed links that are truly dead** (no valid destination):
- Domains that no longer resolve, parked / "for sale" pages, hard 404/410s, and
  links to shut-down services (Google Code, Google+).
- Removal keeps the text intact: a link alone in its paragraph removes the empty
  paragraph; an inline link is unwrapped, keeping the surrounding wording. Dead links
  were **not** replaced with substitutes (no archive snapshots, no guesses).

**3. Reviewed the ambiguous ones by hand**, case by case — e.g. when only a sub-page
404s but the site is fine, I pointed the link to the site instead of deleting it.

Reference links that are intentionally kept even if currently empty (e.g. Wiktionary
script-category pages, which may be populated later) were left untouched on purpose.

The commits are split for easy review: removals, automated URL updates, and the
manual fixes are in separate commits.

## Verification
After applying the changes, I re-ran a full automated audit that re-checks every
link in the current state of the files, and I reviewed the results by hand. Anti-bot
responses (HTTP 403/429 on live sites) were left untouched.

A per-change summary (grouped by type, marked automated vs. manual) is attached to
help review.  [pr_summary.html](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28595648/pr_summary.html)


## Scope
This PR covers `ofl/` only. A follow-up PR will do the same for `catalog/designers/`.

## Tooling note
Link detection, migration and removal were assisted by Claude (Anthropic), model
**Claude Opus 4.8**. All changes were verified by hand before committing.
